name: Pattern Mill
description: An editable manufacturing machine for wallpaper-group carpets. The player touch-paints a small motif grid on the machine head; the mill re-tiles that fragment through one of the 17 wallpaper groups into a live carpet that feeds forward off a roller/tray. Spinning mirror-wedge ROTORS make the symmetry mechanical — their blade count tracks the current group's rotational order (2/3/4/6-fold), so cycling the GROUP re-geometries the machine. Painting updates the carpet live; a discrete PRESS lever punches the head down and re-stamps. Synthesises four prototypes: A (Jacquard touch-toggle + CPU re-tile), B (one reusable texture + dual output), C (fold-order rotors + rebuild discipline), D (operate-stroke + conveyor tray). Reuses WallpaperGroups.get_symmetric_color and PatternSim.PALETTES.
theoreticalGrounding: A pattern is a program plus a fragment. The wallpaper group is the program; the mill is the press that runs it AND the editor that writes it. The fold-order rotors make the group's rotational order a visible, turning mechanism — cycling the group re-counts the blades, so the math is written into the machine's body.

pattern_mill.name: Pattern Mill
pattern_mill.description: Dark industrial frame with emissive accents, a glowing core and fold-order mirror rotors, a glowing warp cage, an editable touch-paint head grid, a press head on guide rods + pull lever, and a live wallpaper-group carpet feeding off a chute/tray plus a vertical proof sheet — both from one reusable texture. Touch-paint the head to edit; GROUP cycles all 17 groups and rebuilds the rotors to the new fold; SEED rerolls a procedural motif; CLEAR blanks it; PRESS punches the head down and re-stamps. DNA: group (p1..p6m), palette (bauhaus/escher/alhambra/tatami/pastel/memphis/persian/monochrome), motif_seed, density, motif_size, machine params.
pattern_mill.qfep_connection: F_order: the 17 wallpaper groups as an editable manufacturing program — constraint multiplied into endless fabric, with the rotational order made a turning mechanism you can edit.
